integrity: The primary full text was inspected at Theorems 1.3--1.5, Lemma 2.6, and the proof of Theorem 1.5. The exact reduction to logarithmic distortion, strict monotonicity, and the quadratic endpoint expansion were independently derived from the displayed source formula. The earlier 2022 quasiregular Bloch estimate was compared at theorem level. No numerical experiment is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result analyzes the explicit coefficient C(K) proved in Theorem 1.5; it does not assert that C(K) is the unknown exact optimal constant for every fixed K>1. The quadratic law is a small-distortion expansion near K=1.
title: Quadratic log-distortion stability of the harmonic quasiregular Bloch coefficient
